root_cause_analysis: Meta API application request limit reached and action blocked by Meta risk systems (Error Code 4, Subcode 2207051). The account or app has triggered automated rate limiting or community protection restriction rules.
actionable_instructions: Halt automated publishing requests to Meta Graph API for at least 1 hour to allow the rate limit/action block window to cool down.
Log into the associated Instagram account via mobile app or web browser to clear any pending security checkpoints or action block prompts.
Verify Meta App dashboard metrics for Graph API usage limits and confirm app permissions status.
